description: Media device topology: input, output and camera counts with per-platform vendor label tables and group pairing. deviceId and groupId are already per-origin HMACs in Chromium, so the fingerprint content is the count, the kind mix, the group pairing and the labels once permission is granted. Labels are vendor-real and platform-correct by construction: a Realtek codec string is a Windows artifact and is not selectable on macOS or Linux.
label: media_topology

options.note: Counts 1/1/1 measured on the Apple M4 Max reference host. The counts are measured; the labels are authored, because label exposure requires a granted permission and the reference capture ran without one (hasLabels false). The built-in microphone and speakers share a groupId because they are one physical device.
AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. A Bluetooth headset appears as one group with both an input and an output.
options.source: Apple AirPods Pro paired over Bluetooth

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. One external display contributes a microphone, speakers and a camera under a single groupId.
AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. A Mac mini or Mac Studio with no peripherals enumerates an output only, which is a real and common topology.
options.source: Apple desktop with no microphone or camera

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. Realtek is the dominant onboard Windows audio codec and its enumerated strings carry the '(Realtek(R) Audio)' suffix.
options.source: Realtek onboard codec with an integrated camera

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. The digital output shares the codec's groupId.
AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. Windows prefixes duplicate USB audio endpoints with an instance number, which is where '2-' comes from.
options.source: USB headset alongside the onboard codec

devices.label: Headset Microphone (2- High Definition Audio Device)

options.note: Counts 0/1/1 measured on the Windows reference host, which enumerated an output and a camera and no microphone at all. The counts are measured; the labels are authored, because label exposure requires a granted permission and the reference capture ran without one (hasLabels false).
AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. A display attached to an NVIDIA GPU contributes an output under the GPU's audio function.
options.source: HDMI or DisplayPort audio from the GPU

options.note: AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED. The PulseAudio card profile name is the label Chromium enumerates, and the analog sink and source are one card.
options.source: PulseAudio or PipeWire analog sink and source

options.note: Counts 0/1/0 measured on the stock Linux reference host, which enumerated one output and nothing else. The counts are measured; the labels are authored, because label exposure requires a granted permission and the reference capture ran without one (hasLabels false).
